title: LEGO SPIKE Simulator challenge
description: A short goal students try from the Challenges window: a field, a check over 5 runs and a few hints, with no steps. See docs/lessons.md or /api/lessons/guide.

goal.description: One or two sentences: what to do, how well, how often and on which realism, e.g. "Stop inside the 6 cm ring of target A, 4 out of 5 times, on Realistic."

level.description: 1 starter, 2 getting there, 3 tricky. Shown as stars.

skill.description: What it practises, for example Basics, Driving, Sensors, Gyro or Missions.

order.description: Position in the list, lowest first.

field.description: Field the challenge is on: a .spk scene name in the library. Starting the challenge loads it.

robot.description: Robot the challenge needs, if not the default: a .mpd or .ldr name in the library.

example.description: A .llsp3 example program in the library that helps with it.

hints.description: Shown one at a time when a student asks for a hint. Nudge, don't give the answer.

draft.description: true hides the challenge from students until a coach publishes it.

author.description: Set by the server: the coach whose AI assistant saved the challenge through the MCP server.
